# Kimi K2.5

Kimi K2.5 is the previous model in the Kimi K2 line. It was released by Moonshot AI in the first half of the year and supports a context window of 128k tokens.

The model is available through the Kimi API. It has 1 trillion total parameters. Its successor, Kimi K2.6, is described in a separate post and report.

K2.5 remains available for customers who have not migrated. Moonshot has said it will keep serving K2.5 for at least six months after the release of its successor, and that pricing will not change in that period.

Reviewers at the time highlighted the model's coding ability and its low price relative to other open-weights models of a similar size.
